items.name: Houston Back to School 2025

venue.name: Norris Conference Center - CityCentre
venue.address: 816 Town and Country Blvd #210, Houston, TX 77024

items.information:
- Please review the [Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/HoustonBacktoSchool2025#55403-competitor-information) tab before the competition.
- Please review the other tabs for more information on the competition.

Please note that the [schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/HoustonBacktoSchool2025#competition-schedule) is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule. 

## ***Please note that no outside food/drink will be permitted in the venue.***   

This competition is supported by Southern Cubing LLC. To learn more about cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/).

items.name: Coffee Cup Tacoma 2025

venue.name: Greater Tacoma Convention Center
venue.details: Third Floor, Ballroom A and B

items.information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CoffeeCupTacoma2025#56208-competitor-responsibilities) tab.
